newsitem.title: USA: AT&T Corp enters phone deal with Teleport.
newsitem.headline: AT&T Corp enters phone deal with Teleport.

text.p: AT&T Corp said Monday it had reached an agreement with Teleport Communications Group Inc to let businesses in nine major cities connect directly with its long-distance network as an alternative to access provided by local phone companies.
AT&T did not disclose the terms of the agreement but said it did not involve an equity investment from it.
The TCG agreement covers the greater metropolitan areas of Boston, Chicago, Detroit, Los Angeles, Miami, Milwaukee, New York, San Diego and San Francisco.
